SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_goods_category WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.icon, c.status, c.create_time, COUNT(g.id) AS goods_count FROM t_goods_category c LEFT JOIN t_goods g ON g.category_id = c.id AND g.status = 'ONLINE' AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.icon, c.status, c.create_time ORDER BY c.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_goods_category (category_name, parent_id, sort_order, icon, status) VALUES (#{categoryName}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{status})
